messages.subject: Project Polaris — capacity check
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Unrelated to Drake — Kingsford have asked us to pick up the next phase on Project Polaris and there's a disclosure exercise that needs a senior associate from mid-February. Are you likely to have capacity once Drake completes, or should I put Elena forward? No rush, just planning resourcing.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500 | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
